text:
Ivy: Quick sync on latency pill placement in the trace rows. Users report it jumps around when callpaths collapse.
Rohan: If pill stays inside the row it moves; pinning to a column keeps it stable but costs horizontal space.
Priya: Accessibility concern: moving elements break predictable tab order. We should keep DOM order stable and use CSS for visuals.
Evan: Agree. If pill is DOM-first before timestamp we can absolutely position it visually without changing keyboard order.
Ivy: That solves keyboard order. Also need an aria-label that includes unit and metric, e.g., 'Latency 240ms (p99)'.
Jo: Microcopy: prefer 'Latency' as label; show 'p99' in tooltip and sr-only text.
Rohan: For narrow screens, show icon-only pill with aria-label='Latency 240ms (p99)'. Tooltip on long-press.
Priya: SR note: add polite aria-live announcements when metric value changes significantly after expand/collapse. Propose threshold >20%.
Evan: Dev caveat: aria-live can be noisy; we'll gate it by delta threshold and only announce when flyout is open or on focus.
Ivy: Export placement: span-level export in kebab menu, full-trace download in header. Also add a 'Copy trace link' quick action by the header for fast sharing.
Jo: Header CTA copy: 'Download trace (JSON / ZIP)'; kebab item: 'Export span (JSON)'; quick action tooltip: 'Includes Correlation ID'.
Rohan: Correlation ID: visual short label 'Corr.' is fine, but sr-only should read 'Correlation ID: <value>'. Include copy button.
Priya: Keyboard flow: make pill focusable only when actionable (opens metrics panel). Otherwise non-interactive with aria-label.
Evan: Implementation: render pill as a button only when actionable; otherwise a span with role='img' and aria-label.
Ivy: Visual contrast: current pill at 60% alpha fails AA for small text. Options: raise to 80% opacity or use a 1px border with white bg.
Jo: Decision recap: 1) Keep pill DOM order stable (before timestamp) and visually reposition via CSS. 2) Icon-only compact mode at small widths. 3) aria-live for >20% deltas. 4) Export: kebab = span export, header = full trace + 'Copy trace link'. 5) Correlation ID: short visual, full sr-only label + copy button. 6) Increase pill contrast.
design-bot: Checklist reminder: contrast check, keyboard nav test, screenreader walkthrough, export JSON validation, Percy snapshots.
Ivy: I'll update Figma with annotated accessibility notes. Priya, can you do the SR walkthrough when mocks are posted?
Priya: Yep, ping me.
Rohan: Dev estimate: DOM change + compact styles + copy button = ~3 dev days; SR tweaks + QA = 1 day.
Ivy: Thanks all, I'll file tickets and link mocks.
